name: Spades Partnership
description: Spades Partnership (often just 'Partnership Spades' or 'Cutthroat Spades' depending on context) refers to specific variations of Spades that emphasize the partnership aspect or introduce specific bidding constraints like 'Suicide' (one partner must bid Nil), 'Mirrors' (bid exactly your Spades), or 'Whiz' (Nil or Spades). It is played with the standard 4-player setup but with modified bidding rules.

content.text: Spades Partnership (often just 'Partnership Spades' or 'Cutthroat Spades' depending on context) refers to specific variations of Spades that emphasize the partnership aspect or introduce specific bidding constraints like 'Suicide' (one partner must bid Nil), 'Mirrors' (bid exactly your Spades), or 'Whiz' (Nil or Spades). It is played with the standard 4-player setup but with modified bidding rules.
Variations emerged as Spades became a household game. 'Suicide' became popular in college dorms to force action.
A standard pack of 52 cards is used. The cards in each suit rank from highest to lowest: A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2. Spades Partnership uses the same deck as basic Spades.

The first dealer is chosen at random; the turn to deal rotates clockwise. The cards are shuffled and dealt singly, clockwise, beginning with the player on the dealer's left, until all 52 cards have been dealt and each player has 13 cards.

items.text: Suicide: One player of each partnership must bid Nil; the other bids normally.
Mirrors: Each player must bid exactly the number of spades in their hand.
Whiz: Players bid either Nil or the number of spades in hand.
